first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation, with inherited evidence of durable activation and faster time-to-value. Verify memory_86 because its downstream adoption evidence is central to the intended action, and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response but may trade margin or customer quality for short-term acquisition; its sustainability evidence is therefore decision-critical.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified source shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing both current activation and onboarding declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline and failed the sustainability objective. Memory_31 provides additional, though unverified this round, evidence of durable SMB activation lift.
